5900: Step into a lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook your elbow outside the front knee.
5901: Stand with your feet wide, back foot turned slightly.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Place one hand down and reach the other arm up as you twist.
5902: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one leg.
Cross the other ankle over the standing thigh.
Bend your standing knee and sit your hips back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with a long spine.
5903: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward from your hips and bring your hands to your shins or thighs.
Lengthen your spine until your back is flat.
5904: Slide one arm under your chest and rest your shoulder on the floor.
Keep your hips over your knees.
5905: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine.
Extend one leg behind you and look slightly forward.
Round your back and draw the knee toward your nose.
Extend again and repeat for 6-8 reps.
5906: Step into a low lunge with your back knee down.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist toward the front leg and hook your elbow outside the knee.
5907: Stand on one leg with your arms overhead.
Hinge forward and lift the back leg behind you.
Bring your torso and back leg level with the floor.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your hips square.
5908: Sit with one leg extended and the other foot against your inner thigh.
Rotate your chest toward the extended leg.
Reach one arm overhead and bend over the leg.
5910: Hang chains on a barbell and stand with a wide stance, toes pointed out.
Grip the bar inside your knees with a flat back.
Push the floor away and drive your knees out.
Stand tall as the chains lift and the load increases.
Lock out with your glutes, then lower the bar under control.
5911: Set the safety bar on your upper back and shoulders and hold the handles.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso until it is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
5912: Loop chains over the ends of a barbell and take a wide stance, toes angled out.
Bend down and grip the bar with your hands inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push through your feet and stand, with the chains adding load as you rise.
Lock out your hips, then lower the bar with control.
5913: Step into a wide warrior II stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Reach your front arm up and lean back.
Rest your back hand on your leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then switch.
5914: Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower.
Keep your body straight like a plank.
Hold briefly, then press back up.
5915: Start in a high plank and lift one leg behind you.
Bend your elbows back and lower.
Hold briefly with your body in line.
Press up, lower the leg and switch.
5916: Sit facing away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to extend the handle up.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Keep your torso upright and your upper arms still.
5917: Lie on your back and bend your knees toward your chest.
Hold the outsides of your feet.
Open your knees wide toward your armpits.
Rock gently side to side and hold for 5 slow breaths.
5921: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with palm facing in, thumb up.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arm is nearly straight.
Complete your reps, then switch arms or alternate.
5938: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands together in front of you.
Twist and chop your arms diagonally across your body.
Return to center and chop the other way.
Keep your chest tall and your core tight.
5943: Stand facing away from a low pulley and hold the handle with a neutral grip.
Keep your arm nearly straight and your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to about shoulder height.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
5944: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side with palm facing in.
Brace your core and keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Avoid swinging, finish all reps and switch arms.
5963: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up and reach toward your feet.
Lower your upper body slowly to the floor.
5965: Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Take quick steps in the set pattern, one then two.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your arms bent and swinging naturally.
Repeat for 20-30 seconds with sharp, light steps.
5966: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a slight squat.
Jump up and rotate your hips and feet to one side.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep your chest up and land quietly.
5967: Set up with a ball in front of you in an athletic stance.
Move quickly around or over the ball with short, light steps.
Keep your hips low and eyes up.
Change direction without crossing your feet.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.
5968: Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Perform a push-up if you like.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Explode up, rotating your trunk as you jump, and land softly.
5969: Mark five dots on the floor like the five on a die.
Stand on the balls of your feet next to the pattern.
Hop quickly from dot to dot in your chosen order.
Keep your hops small and your knees soft.
5970: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides.
Place your right heel directly in front of your left toes.
Shift your weight forward and step again with the other foot.
Keep your eyes forward and your core gently braced.
Walk 10-15 steps, then turn around and return.
5971: Place three cones in an L shape, about 5 yards apart.
Sprint from the start cone to the second and touch it.
Sprint to the second again, turn around the cone and weave around the third.
Return to the start along the same line.
5972: Lay an agility ladder flat on the ground.
Stand at the start in an athletic stance.
Step quickly with both feet into each square, one after another.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms and keep your eyes up.
Jog back and repeat for several rounds.
5973: Stand sideways at the start of an agility ladder.
Step both feet into the first square, one at a time.
Move sideways to the next square with quick steps.
Keep your hips low and your feet light.
Finish the ladder, then repeat facing the other way.
5974: Set out a few markers within a small area.
Stand in an athletic stance on the balls of your feet.
Hop or step quickly between the markers in changing directions.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.
5975: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and fists up.
Throw a cross punch, rotating your hips and shoulders.
Pull your fist back to guard.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
5976: Set four cones in a T with the top cones 5 yards apart.
Sprint forward to the center cone and touch it.
Shuffle sideways to the left cone and touch it.
Shuffle across to the right cone, then back to the middle.
Keep your hips low and feet from crossing.
5977: Place a line of tape on the floor or imagine one.
Stand at one end with your arms out for balance.
Walk heel to toe along the line.
Keep your gaze ahead and your core braced.
Turn at the end and walk back.
5978: Stand tall with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Kick one straight leg up toward your hands.
Keep your chest upright and walk for about 10 reps per side.
5979: Set four cones in a square, with a center point.
Sprint diagonally from one corner through the center to the opposite corner.
Shuffle sideways along one edge to the next corner.
Stay low through turns and repeat.
5980: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward and step back to plank.
Lower, then press into upward dog and downward dog.
Step forward, rise and return to mountain.
Repeat the flow at a steady pace.
5981: Stand in mountain pose and sit into a chair pose with your arms overhead.
Fold forward, step back to plank and flow through chaturanga.
Step forward into warrior I on each side, then flow again.
Link every move to your breath.
5982: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward with a long spine.
Lift halfway up with a flat back.
Fold again and rise up with your arms overhead.
Lower your hands to your heart and repeat.
5983: Lower to chaturanga with your elbows by your ribs.
Roll forward into upward dog with an open chest.
Lift your hips to downward dog.
Hold for a breath or two and repeat.
5984: Set a cone line a few yards apart.
Sprint to the first cone and touch it, then back to the start.
Sprint to the second cone and back.
Go to the third cone and back.
5985: Toss a balloon into the air in an open space.
Stay on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Move under the balloon and tap it up.
Use small hops to reach it.
5986: Place several cones in a pattern a few yards apart.
Sprint or shuffle around the cones in order.
Plant and cut with your hips low.
Finish the course, rest, then go again.
5988: Hold a bottle in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Lower the bottles along your legs to mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
5989: Set two cones about 5 yards apart.
Start next to one cone in an athletic stance.
Run a figure-eight around both cones.
Lean into the turns and keep your hips low.
Run for 20-30 seconds, then change direction.
5990: Stand facing a high hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump over it, tucking your knees.
Plant and cut sharply to one side.
Walk back and repeat, alternating cut directions.
5991: Face a partner about 2 yards away in an athletic stance.
Have your partner move left or right.
Shuffle sideways to mirror them without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and chest up.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then swap roles.
5997: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Push your body up into a straight plank.
Lower yourself all the way down until your chest rests on the floor.
Relax briefly, then push up again.
5998: Lie on your left side with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and place that foot in front of you.
Raise your left leg a few inches off the floor.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
